body:
Goal: Review and approve README.md.
Task: T2 is yours (depends on T1).
When T1 finishes and Engineer hands off:
1. Verify README.md against real wordfreq.py behavior by running wordfreq.py yourself.
2. If issues are found, send a short list of fixes to Engineer.
3. Once satisfied, approve with 'hermes-crew board approve README.md "<what was checked>"' and complete T2.
